Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan and next steps — Magnus BioTech pilot

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for a constructive call today. Quick write-up to capture what we heard, confirm priorities, and propose a lightweight mutual action plan (attached) so we all have the same timeline. Please correct anything that’s off.

Top pain / goals you shared
- High latency and cost for on-prem inference of named-entity extraction and clinical-coding workflows; current batch overnight runs introduce >12 hour turnaround.
- Need predictable per-request latency sub-300ms for inference while keeping TPU/GPU spend within procurement thresholds.
- Regulatory constraint: patient PHI cannot leave VPC; solution must integrate with existing on-prem infra or a VPC private deployment.

Success criteria for pilot
- Deploy a private Redwood inference instance in their VPC that handles 1k concurrent requests at median latency <300ms for 512-token context.
- Demonstrate end-to-end throughput improvements versus current pipeline (target: 4x faster processing for daily batches).
- Validate data residency and logging controls required by Magnus security/compliance team.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level) — detailed rows in attached MPA workbook
1) Week 0–1: Kickoff & access — Magnus to provide VPC access details, security contacts, and list of sample workloads (Asha)
2) Week 2: Private deployment & baseline test — Redwood to provision a pre-prod VPC instance and run synthetic baseline (Jordan / infra)
3) Week 3–4: Integration & model tuning — joint runs on sample data, latency/cost tuning, and prefix/KV caching configuration (Marissa / Magnus Eng)
4) Week 5: Security review & evidence exchange — SOC2/HIPAA checklist items, KMS options, and audit log format (Vivek / Magnus security)
5) Week 6: Pilot sign-off & next steps — decision meeting to discuss Dedicated vs Hosted options and commercial terms (all)

Immediate asks from our side
- Access: VPC peering details or temporary jump host for the infra team (needed by EOD Fri, 7/9).
- Sample data: 2 representative jobs (anonymized) and expected QPS.
- Procurement: pointer to procurement contact and standard PO/contract terms we should expect.

Attachments: MPA_Magnus_20270707.xlsx (spreadsheet) and Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (one-page security summary)

If that looks right, I’ll update the MPA with the dates you prefer and circulate a DocuSign link for the pilot SOW.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

Thanks Jordan — really clear summary, appreciate it. A few notes from our side: 

1) Timeline tweak: can we move the security review window to Week 4 instead of Week 5? Our compliance team has availability the week of 7/26 and that would let us keep momentum.
2) Access: I’ll ask infra to share a temporary jump host and anonymized sample payloads by 7/9 — I’ll confirm by EOD Thu.
3) Procurement: looping in procurement (procurement@magnusbio.com) — they will want standard IP terms and an estimated cost range for the pilot before we sign.

Question: Do you have a short SOC2 artifact or an evidence bundle we can share with our security team now so they can start internal review? Also, can you confirm whether the private deployment supports our on-prem HSM for KMS?

If you can make the Week 4 security review change and attach the SOC2 one-pager, we’ll be ready to move.

Best,
